Vocabulary — SKOS concept schemes

Every tag string in this project, as an addressable concept with a URI, an English and (where known) a Hebrew label, and a link to Wikidata. Machine-readable copies: vocab.jsonld · vocab.ttl · what this is

How to read the Authority column. Q123= means skos:exactMatch — the same thing. Q123≈ means skos:closeMatch — related but not identical, used where our shorthand has no exact counterpart. A match is asserted on one of two gates, and the last column says which: a matching label plus a P31/P279 statement licensing the type (127 terms), or a matching label alone where no type list was defined for that group (91 terms). The earlier wording here said every match had passed both, which was not true - corrected 4 August 2026.
Anchoring: 1895 of 18906 verbatim spans (10.0%) resolve inside the published page text; restricted to pages that carry full text (the rights audit made 17011 spans link-only), 1895/1895 = 100.0%.
